title: TF2 Frying Pan
blurb: Cast iron meeting a skull, and Valve knew precisely what it was doing. The Frying Pan arrived in Team Fortress 2 in 2011 as a cosmetic melee reskin with an absurdly loud hit sound, and the community immediately decided it was the funniest weapon in the game: no mechanical advantage, audible across an entire map, guaranteed to humiliate whoever is on the receiving end. The clang has long since escaped TF2 into general meme usage. Nothing punctuates a video edit quite so decisively.
origin: The Frying Pan melee hit from Team Fortress 2 (Valve, 2011).
